ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels (distal lobes) and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (central peduncle and medial margins).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous black 'blob' originating at the peduncle and extending outward along the medial trailing edges, featuring irregular, feathered boundaries. Distal 70% of both lobes are high-intensity white with isolated low-intensity speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 55 degrees; depth is approximately 1/6th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate, irregular serration along the length of the trailing edge; frequency increases significantly towards the tips. Left distal tip shows high-amplitude irregular jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to a sharp, slightly upwards-turned sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, dark-linear pixel disruption oriented diagonally in the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion and brownish biological encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes; prominent dark rake mark on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronest brownish-orange coloration on the extreme distal tips, contrasting with the black/white pigmentation of the fluke surface.
